title: Sage ragdoll record
description: A ragdoll record (RagdollRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another ragdoll record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

model.description: The skinned model (.glb) whose skeleton these bodies are on. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

bodies.description: Bodies by joint name, as the model writes it ("thigh_l") (Dictionary<string, RagdollBodyData>)

size.description: Capsule: radius, length of the cylinder between the caps. Box: full extents. Sphere: radius. Unit: m. (Vector3)

offset.description: The body's centre in the joint's space. Unit: m. (Vector3)

angles.description: How the shape is turned in the joint's space: pitch, yaw, roll. Unit: deg. (Vector3)

mass.description: Its mass. Unit: kg. At least 0. (float)

joint.description: The joint to the nearest ancestor joint that has a body; none on the root body. (RagdollJointData)

kind.description: Ball: swings in a cone and twists. Hinge: turns about one axis between min and max. (RagdollJointKind)

swing.description: Ball: the cone's half-angle the bone may swing from where it hangs. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 180. (float)

twistMin.description: Ball: how far it may twist one way about the axis. Unit: deg. Range: -180 to 180. (float)

twistMax.description: Ball: how far it may twist the other way about the axis. Unit: deg. Range: -180 to 180. (float)

axis.description: In the joint's space: the hinge's axis, or a ball's twist axis; (0, 0, 0) = the bone's own direction, +Y. (Vector3)

min.description: Hinge: the lowest angle about the axis. Unit: deg. Range: -180 to 180. (float)

max.description: Hinge: the highest angle about the axis. Unit: deg. Range: -180 to 180. (float)

friction.description: Friction of every body. At least 0. (float, default 0.6)

damping.description: Linear and angular damping of every body: the share of its speed lost each second. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0.1)

settleSpeed.description: Slower than this, a body is at rest. Unit: m/s. At least 0. (float, default 0.15)

settleTime.description: Every body at rest this long and the ragdoll has settled. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 1)
